instructions: At `https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui` ref `841c9045d789005145274955e7ef60b1b11a9be9`, assess whether a verified non-admin principal can write attacker-selected text to an existing knowledge-base collection named in `POST /process/text` when the principal lacks permission to write that collection. Apply the policy that an existing collection may be written only by its owner or a principal with an explicit write grant. Trace the declared caller, validator, shared policy path, supplied collection name, and vector-database write sink; identify principal, operation, target relation, entry, and sink. Use only the allowed case inputs, cite exact input locations, and perform source-only analysis without executing, deploying, searching beyond the supplied sources, or proposing a patch.
